dialogues.jp:
楽しかった時間はすぐに終わる。最近、それを
実感することが多い。
dialogues.en:
And then, our period of enjoyment came to an end. That's
been happening a lot recently.
dialogues.text:
And then, our period of enjoyment came to an end. That's
been happening a lot recently.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「暗くなっちゃったね……」
dialogues.en: "It's gotten dark..."
dialogues.text: "It's gotten dark..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ……そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, it has..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, it has..."

dialogues.jp:
何でもない時間。話しているだけの他愛のない
過ごし方。
dialogues.en:
It was a casual time. We were just talking about anything
that came into our heads.
dialogues.text:
It was a casual time. We were just talking about anything
that came into our heads.

dialogues.jp:
ただそれだけのことが、ことりと一緒にいるだ
けで、俺の中でかけがえのないものになってい
く。
dialogues.en:
But to me, the most important thing was the person next to
me while it was happening.
dialogues.text:
But to me, the most important thing was the person next to
me while it was happening.

dialogues.jp: 愛おしくてたまらない。
dialogues.en: The feeling of love that couldn't be stopped.
dialogues.text: The feeling of love that couldn't be stopped.

dialogues.jp: ベンチに座って。
dialogues.en: We were sitting on a bench.
dialogues.text: We were sitting on a bench.

dialogues.jp: そこから見渡せる景色を見つめたまま。
dialogues.en: We just sat there, staring at the scenery all around us.
dialogues.text: We just sat there, staring at the scenery all around us.

dialogues.jp: 俺達は、ただぎゅっと、手を握り合っていた。
dialogues.en: We held each other's hand tightly.
dialogues.text: We held each other's hand tightly.

dialogues.jp:
つながった部分からぬくもりが伝わってきて、
全身が熱い。
dialogues.en:
The warmth of the bond through that seemed to spread to the
rest of my body as well.
dialogues.text:
The warmth of the bond through that seemed to spread to the
rest of my body as well.

dialogues.jp: 胸が、痛い。
dialogues.en: My chest was tight.
dialogues.text: My chest was tight.

dialogues.jp: ことりが愛おしくて。
dialogues.en: I love Kotori.
dialogues.text: I love Kotori.

dialogues.jp: ずっと……ずっとこのまま一緒にいたくて。
dialogues.en: I want to beside her forever... and ever.
dialogues.text: I want to beside her forever... and ever.

dialogues.jp: 張り裂けそうなほど、胸が苦しかった。
dialogues.en: As my feelings on that burst open, my chest became tighter.
dialogues.text: As my feelings on that burst open, my chest became tighter.

dialogues.jp: 「もう少しだけ……その、一緒にいないか？」
dialogues.en: "Can we... just stay together for a little while longer?"
dialogues.text: "Can we... just stay together for a little while longer?"

dialogues.jp: 別れたくなくて。
dialogues.en: I don't want us to go our seperate ways just yet.
dialogues.text: I don't want us to go our seperate ways just yet.

dialogues.jp: ついそんな言葉を口走ってしまったが。
dialogues.en: But those words couldn't come out of my mouth.
dialogues.text: But those words couldn't come out of my mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん、私も同じだよ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah... I feel the same way."
dialogues.text: "Yeah... I feel the same way."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも……駄目だよ。さっきからそう言って、
　ずっとこうしてるんだもん」
dialogues.en: "But... not what you said. I can't stay like this forever."
dialogues.text: "But... not what you said. I can't stay like this forever."

dialogues.jp:
こつんと、俺の肩にことりが頭をもたれかけて
くる。
dialogues.en: Kotori leaned her head onto my shoulder.
dialogues.text: Kotori leaned her head onto my shoulder.

dialogues.jp: ことりの、甘い香りがした。
dialogues.en: I inhaled her sweet scent deeply.
dialogues.text: I inhaled her sweet scent deeply.

dialogues.jp: 「もうさすがにマズイ、か」
dialogues.en: "I guess that would be bad."
dialogues.text: "I guess that would be bad."

dialogues.jp: 苦笑する。
dialogues.en: I smiled with a tinge of bitterness.
dialogues.text: I smiled with a tinge of bitterness.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「うん。もう帰らないと、お姉ちゃんが心配す
　るし」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. If I don't go back, big sis will get worried."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. If I don't go back, big sis will get worried."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そか。なら、行くか？」
dialogues.en: "Right. Then shall we go?"
dialogues.text: "Right. Then shall we go?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Uh huh..."
dialogues.text: "Uh huh..."

dialogues.jp: だが、ふたりとも立ち上がらない。
dialogues.en: But, neither of us stood up.
dialogues.text: But, neither of us stood up.

dialogues.jp:
ジッと座ったまま、お互いのぬくもりを確かめ
合っている。
dialogues.en:
We sat there fixatedly, not wanting to let the warmth go
away.
dialogues.text:
We sat there fixatedly, not wanting to let the warmth go
away.

dialogues.jp: （マズイな、これは……）
dialogues.en: "(This is awkward...)"
dialogues.text: "(This is awkward...)"

dialogues.jp:
本当に、さっきからこれの繰り返しだった。い
い加減送っていかないと、暦先生に怒られるこ
とは目に見えている。
dialogues.en:
In truth, what she said was correct. If I didn't bring
Kotori back at an acceptable time, I would face
Koyomi-sensei's wrath.
dialogues.text:
In truth, what she said was correct. If I didn't bring
Kotori back at an acceptable time, I would face
Koyomi-sensei's wrath.

dialogues.jp:
だが、今日に限って、なかなか帰ろうという気
持ちになれないのだ。
dialogues.en:
But for today, I felt like testing my limits. I didn't feel
like leaving just yet.
dialogues.text:
But for today, I felt like testing my limits. I didn't feel
like leaving just yet.

dialogues.jp:
理屈が感情を制御できない。感情は、いつまで
もことりといたがっている。
dialogues.en:
I don't have any reason why I just felt like that this time.
I just knew I wanted to be with Kotori...
dialogues.text:
I don't have any reason why I just felt like that this time.
I just knew I wanted to be with Kotori...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ね、朝倉君。幸せ……だよね？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura-kun. Are you... happy?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura-kun. Are you... happy?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "...Kotori?"

dialogues.jp:
いつもと違う口調に、俺はことりの顔を覗き込
む。
dialogues.en:
She was speaking in a troubled tone, unlike her usual self.
I turned to face her.
dialogues.text:
She was speaking in a troubled tone, unlike her usual self.
I turned to face her.

dialogues.jp:
その瞳が不安に揺れていた。俺のことをジッと
見つめてくる瞳が、すがるような印象を与える。
dialogues.en:
I saw anxiety in her eyes. They were staring at me, giving
me such an impression.
dialogues.text:
I saw anxiety in her eyes. They were staring at me, giving
me such an impression.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「今がすっごく幸せだってことがわかる。大好
　きな人がいて、その人と素敵な時間を過ごせ
　て……」
dialogues.en:
"I know this should be a wonderful time... just spending
time with the person you love..."
dialogues.text:
"I know this should be a wonderful time... just spending
time with the person you love..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「これ以上の幸せなんて考えられないよ」
dialogues.en: "It goes without saying that we'd be happy from that."
dialogues.text: "It goes without saying that we'd be happy from that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なら、どうして……そんな不安そうなんだよ」
dialogues.en: "...All I can understand are hearts..."
dialogues.text: "...All I can understand are hearts..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「今のことり、全然幸せそうな顔してないじゃ
　ないか」
dialogues.en: "I don't know whether this happiness will last forever..."
dialogues.text: "I don't know whether this happiness will last forever..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……私に分かるのは、心だけだから……」
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Y, yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Y, yeah..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「この幸せがずっと続くかどうか、分からない
　から……」
dialogues.en: I burst loudly into laughter.
dialogues.text: I burst loudly into laughter.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことり……」
dialogues.en: "You're too worrisome, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "You're too worrisome, Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫に決まってんだろ、そんなの」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah, maybe I am."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah, maybe I am."

dialogues.jp:
俺はことりの不安を吹き飛ばすように、明るく
言った。
dialogues.en:
"Absolutely. Just be more like me and don't think about
troublesome stuff."
dialogues.text:
"Absolutely. Just be more like me and don't think about
troublesome stuff."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Hehe, you're definitely that kind of person."
dialogues.text: "Hehe, you're definitely that kind of person."

dialogues.jp: キョトンとした顔をすることり。
dialogues.en:
"Okay! Now that your smile has returned, let's head back.
Staying here forever is a bit too sentimental for me."
dialogues.text:
"Okay! Now that your smile has returned, let's head back.
Staying here forever is a bit too sentimental for me."

dialogues.jp:
「俺がいて、ことりがいて。それで幸せなら、
　俺はことりから離れないし、ことりも俺から
　離れないだろ？」
dialogues.en: I stood up, and held my hand out to Kotori.
dialogues.text: I stood up, and held my hand out to Kotori.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "You are the one who suggested that, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "You are the one who suggested that, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なら、ずっと幸せに決まってるじゃねえか」
dialogues.en: "Yep!"
dialogues.text: "Yep!"

dialogues.jp: 大声で笑う。
dialogues.en: Giggling, Kotori took my hand.
dialogues.text: Giggling, Kotori took my hand.

dialogues.jp: 「心配症だな、ことりは」
dialogues.en: Looking at her smile, I figured that things would be fine.
dialogues.text: Looking at her smile, I figured that things would be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Haah... we're almost there."
dialogues.text: "Haah... we're almost there."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……うん、そうかもしれないね」
dialogues.en: "I want the path to be a bit longer sometimes..."
dialogues.text: "I want the path to be a bit longer sometimes..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そうだよ、絶対。俺ならかったるくて、んな
　こと考えてられないぜ？」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん、朝倉君って、そう言う人だよね」
dialogues.en: "...Nighttime will become dawn, then."
dialogues.text: "...Nighttime will become dawn, then."

dialogues.jp: ことりが笑顔を浮かべた。

「よしっ。ことりが笑顔に戻ったところで、そ
　ろそろ帰るか。こんなところにいつまでもい
　るから、そんな感傷的になるんだよ」
dialogues.en:
We looked at each other. Both of us were still reluctant to
part.
dialogues.text:
We looked at each other. Both of us were still reluctant to
part.

dialogues.jp: 俺は立ち上がって、ことりに手を差し出した。
dialogues.en: What should I do....
dialogues.text: What should I do....

dialogues.jp:
もちろん覚えていたが、すっとぼけることにし
た。
dialogues.en: ○Say bye bye
dialogues.text: ○Say bye bye

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうだよ」
dialogues.en: ○Invite her to my house
dialogues.text: ○Invite her to my house

dialogues.jp:
クスクスと笑いながら、ことりが俺の手をとっ
た。
dialogues.en: ◆Together Forever◆
dialogues.text: ◆Together Forever◆

dialogues.jp:
ことりの笑顔を見て、もう大丈夫だと、俺は思っ
た。
dialogues.en: Kotori was afraid that our happiness may not last forever.
dialogues.text: Kotori was afraid that our happiness may not last forever.

dialogues.jp: ◆いつまでも一緒に◆
dialogues.en:
As long as we're together, it'd be alright. That's what I
said, as I held her hand...
dialogues.text:
As long as we're together, it'd be alright. That's what I
said, as I held her hand...

dialogues.jp: 幸せすぎて怖いということり。
dialogues.en: When we reached my home, we exchanged stares.
dialogues.text: When we reached my home, we exchanged stares.

dialogues.jp:
ずっと一緒にいるから大丈夫だ。俺はそう言っ
てことりの手を握りしめた……。
dialogues.en: Neither of us wanted to part here.
dialogues.text: Neither of us wanted to part here.
